description: Refusal gate: logistic model of P(the asserted answer is correct). Refuse when p < threshold.

feature_definitions.top: reranker logit of the top evidence chunk
feature_definitions.sentence: cross-encoder score of (sub-query, '<title of top chunk>: <claim sentence>')
feature_definitions.overlap_ce: share of the sub-query's content tokens present in the claim sentence
feature_definitions.overlap_section: share of the sub-query's content tokens present in the top chunk's whole section
feature_definitions.margin: top evidence logit minus second evidence logit (0 if only one)
feature_definitions.reader_margin: SQuAD2 reader: best span score minus the lowest no-answer score over the top-3 chunks

fitted_on: HeySQuAD human validation (yijingwu/HeySQuAD_human@2a9aff60), dev-corpus articles only
threshold_rule: maximise expected utility on DEV with p_unanswerable=0.3, cost of a wrong answer c=1.0 (U = (1-p)(recall - c*wrong_rate) - p*c*answered_unanswerable_rate)
